title: No trump can save this trick

feedback.title: A guaranteed trick in Sans
feedback.summary: West has already shown void in Hearts, and in Sans only Hearts can win this trick — North and East have already played below the king, and West cannot add a Heart to challenge it.
points: The earlier trick shows West playing a club when Hearts were led, so West holds no more Hearts this hand.
In Sans, a card that cannot follow the led suit can never win the trick — West's response cannot beat any Heart you play.
No higher Heart remains to be added to this trick: North and East have already played, and West cannot follow suit.

feedback.title: Giving away a trick you can already win
feedback.summary: Playing the two lets the nine of Hearts win instead; the king guarantees this trick in Sans, and the target's exact estimate still requires both of the two remaining tricks.
points: The earlier trick already showed West void in Hearts, so nothing remaining in this trick can beat the king.
In Sans, West's forced off-suit card cannot win this trick regardless of what West plays.
The target's exact estimate still requires both remaining tricks; giving up a trick the king guarantees moves it into the harder, uncertain remainder.

author_notes: Second void-tracking scenario (EC-042). Sans removes the usual trump risk entirely: once West is confirmed void in the led suit, no card West holds can win this trick, making the king a fully certain winner rather than merely a probable one.
